units.source_text: 乍看，经过人工化妆的女人的面孔几乎都是一副模样；

en.t: At first glance, the faces of women made up by artifice all seemed almost the same;

units.source_text: 细看，却可以发现其性格的微妙差异。

en.t: but on closer inspection, one could discern subtle differences in their character.

units.source_text: 透过白粉胭脂相同的假面具，可以看到明暗和明朗，

en.t: Through the identical masks of face powder and rouge, one could see shades of darkness and brightness,

units.source_text: 灵活的智慧和美丽的愚昧，不愉快和无限度的快活，

en.t: nimble intelligence and beautiful folly, displeasure and boundless cheerfulness,

units.source_text: 不幸和幸运等等多彩的色调活现出来了。

en.t: unhappiness and good fortune, and all such varied colors came vividly to life.

units.source_text: 我好不容易才找到了我想要的一。

en.t: Only with great difficulty did I finally find the one I wanted.

units.source_text: 这张照片在店里璀璨灯光的照耀下，

en.t: This photograph, under the dazzling lights in the shop,

units.source_text: 其亮光纸面光灿灿反射，使我差点疏漏过去了。

en.t: reflected brilliantly from its glossy surface, so that I nearly overlooked it.

units.source_text: 不过，拿在手中，照片就没有反光，

en.t: However, once I held it in my hand, the photograph no longer reflected the light,

units.source_text: 身穿褐红色大衣的女人的面孔就现出来了。

en.t: and the face of the woman wearing a reddish-brown overcoat emerged.
